responsibility: This file implements the stateful pretty printer that mc uses during code emission. It tracks indentation, line and column positions, delayed spaces, line breaks encoded in strings, and nested formatting contexts via push/pop, while delegating actual character output to caller-supplied write procedures. It is the formatting engine behind decl’s generated source output rather than a syntax or semantic analysis component.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements mcPretty’s formatter state machine, including the pretty record fields, push/pop stack handling, deferred spacing/indent flushing, and newline interpretation. The sibling mcPretty.def only exposes the abstract API.
